comment: The time knob is quadratic so the short delays take more of the turn; the tooltip reads 35ms to 1175ms. Feedback is configured 0 to 1.8 and displayed as 0 to 100 per cent of that, so the panel's 180 per cent is the parameter's 1.8. The fb mix knob starts at 1, fully on the return, which is why patching the return jack changes the sound at once. The send carries the feedback signal in Eurorack volts and the return is scaled back down by ten on the way in. The lamp follows isConnected on the return jack. The panel prints MMCCCXCIX, time, bright, fb, fb mix, wet, then time, bright, fb, fb mix and wet again over the CV jacks, and send, return, in and out.
